scenes: Who in a city is in charge of heat?
Often, nobody, because heat touches every department: | health, water, power, schools and work. | A chief heat officer joins them up, before the hot season.
In 2023, Dhaka North City Corporation appointed Asia’s first.
Heat crosses every department. Someone has to join them up.
